<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Rota das Grandes Navegações — Individual</title>
<style>
:root{--ink:#2d1f13;--paper:#fff8e8;--line:#987044;--good:#2f7b4b;--bad:#aa433a;--gold:#ad761f;--shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(54,34,12,.22)}
*{box-sizing:border-box} body{margin:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d4b986,#ead9b0);color:var(--ink);font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif}
button,input{font:inherit} button{cursor:pointer}
.app{max-width:1800px;margin:auto;padding:10px}
.header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:rgba(255,249,233,.97);border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:10px 14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.header h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(1.5rem,2.5vw,2.5rem)} .header p{margin:3px 0 0;color:#6a5137}
.btn{border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 13px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;background:#6e4d2e;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #4d351f} .btn.good{background:var(--good)} .btn.bad{background:var(--bad)} .btn.gold{background:var(--gold)} .btn.secondary{background:#7d6952} .btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.35fr) minmax(410px,.75fr);gap:10px;margin-top:10px;align-items:start}
.panel{background:rgba(255,249,234,.98);border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden}
.maphead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #bea174;background:linear-gradient(#fff9ec,#f2e1bf)} .legend{font:800 .82rem Arial,sans-serif;color:#664c32}
